name: list_tables
description: List all table names in the database.

name: describe_table
description: Describe a table's columns (name and declared SQL type).

name: run_query
description: Execute a single read-only SELECT statement against the database and return its columns and rows (capped at 20 rows). Use this to explore and sanity-check a query before giving your final answer. Non-SELECT statements and multiple statements are rejected.
